description_for_human: A local pet rewards and services platform connecting pet owners with trusted businesses while rewarding everyday pet spending.
description_for_model: PawBucks is an all-in-one pet ecosystem and digital payment platform. Pet owners discover local pet merchants (stores, groomers, trainers, vets), make payments, and earn PawBucks rewards (10x-30x per dollar). Features include digital wallet, pet store marketplace, lost pet alerts, pet health records, and merchant discovery. 1,000 PawBucks = $1. Free to use with premium PawPass tiers available.
description_for_voice: PawBucks is a pet rewards app. Say find pet stores near me to discover local pet businesses. Say how do I earn PawBucks to learn about rewards. Say report a lost pet to create a lost pet alert. Say shop the pet store to browse pet products with cashback rewards.
